brief: 6 edge runtimes that shipped real production wins in 2026.

slots.title: Cloudflare Workers
slots.subtitle: The V8 isolates runtime cut global latency to under 10ms for millions of requests.
slots.b1Body: Push code to 300+ cities in under 30 seconds with no container boot time.
slots.b2Body: Native WebAssembly support unlocked CPU-heavy tasks at the edge.
slots.b3Body: Automatic inference moved stateful objects closest to users dynamically.

slots.title: Deno Deploy
slots.subtitle: Secure-by-default V8 isolates eliminated config sprawl for API backends.
slots.b1Body: No build step required; TS compiles directly inside the isolate runtime.
slots.b2Body: Global strongly-consistent key-value reduced database roundtrips by 80%.
slots.b3Body: Zero-config identity layer protected routes without middleware bloat.

slots.title: Vercel Edge
slots.subtitle: Middleware and SSR moved from servers to the edge without breaking npm packages.
slots.b1Body: Full compatibility with Buffer, crypto, and streams removed migration friction.
slots.b2Body: React Server Components rendered progressively from the nearest region.
slots.b3Body: Sticky edge sessions pinned user state to a single geography for compliance.

slots.title: Netlify Edge
slots.subtitle: Serverless logic lives next to frontend code and deploys on every git push.
slots.b1Body: Every PR spawned an isolated edge environment with unique env vars.
slots.b2Body: Stale-while-revalidate cached dynamic pages at the CDN automatically.
slots.b3Body: Mutable edge blobs replaced S3 for user-generated content uploads.

slots.title: Fastly Compute
slots.subtitle: WebAssembly-powered compute processes requests in microseconds, not milliseconds.
slots.b1Body: First-class Rust and JS toolchains compiled to WASM with tiny bundle sizes.
slots.b2Body: Real-time config propagation hit all POPs in under 500ms without restarts.
slots.b3Body: Coalesced backend requests prevented thundering herd on inventory APIs.

slots.title: Supabase Edge
slots.subtitle: Deno functions running next to Postgres reduced data latency to sub-millisecond.
slots.b1Body: Postgres triggers invoked edge functions directly on row changes.
slots.b2Body: JWT validation reused existing Supabase sessions with zero external calls.
slots.b3Body: Edge functions published to WebSocket channels without hitting the origin.

slots.ctaBody: Edge runtimes are production-standard in 2026. Choose isolation, speed, and zero cold starts.
